Task: Preserve custom Accept-Language on XHR requests while retaining global fallback for other requests and domain overrides.

+from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch, usertypes
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize('dnt, accept_language, custom_headers, expected', [
@@ -35,6 +36,24 @@ def test_custom_headers(config_stub, dnt, accept_language, custom_headers,
     assert shared.custom_headers(url=None) == expected_items
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('url, fallback, override, expected', [
+    (None, False, None, b'global'),
+    (QUrl('https://example.org/'), True, None, b'global'),
+    (QUrl('https://example.org/'), False, None, None),
+    (QUrl('https://example.org/'), False, 'local', b'local'),
+])
+def test_custom_headers_accept_language_fallback(config_stub, url, fallback,
+                                                 override, expected):
+    config_stub.val.content.headers.accept_language = 'global'
+    if override is not None:
+        config_stub.set_obj('content.headers.accept_language', override,
+                            pattern=urlmatch.UrlPattern('example.org'))
+
+    headers = dict(shared.custom_headers(
+        url=url, fallback_accept_language=fallback))
+    assert headers.get(b'Accept-Language') == expected
+
+

diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengineinterceptor.py b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengineinterceptor.py
index 099ba69..f9d1e2f 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengineinterceptor.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webengineinterceptor.py
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@ pytest.importorskip("qutebrowser.qt.webenginecore")
 from qutebrowser.qt.core import QUrl, QByteArray
 from qutebrowser.qt.webenginecore import QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo
 
+from qutebrowser.browser import shared
 from qutebrowser.browser.webengine import interceptor
 from qutebrowser.extensions import interceptors
 from qutebrowser.utils import qtutils
@@ -37,6 +38,34 @@ def test_resource_type_values():
         assert qtutils.extract_enum_val(qt_value) == qb_item.value
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('resource_type, fallback', [
+    (QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo.ResourceType.ResourceTypeXhr, False),
+    (QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo.ResourceType.ResourceTypeMainFrame, True),
+])
+def test_accept_language_fallback_for_request_type(
+        config_stub, mocker, resource_type, fallback):
+    config_stub.val.content.headers.accept_language = 'global'
+    info = mocker.Mock(spec=QWebEngineUrlRequestInfo)
+    url = QUrl('https://example.org/')
+    info.requestUrl.return_value = url
+    info.firstPartyUrl.return_value = url
+    info.resourceType.return_value = resource_type
+    mocker.patch.object(interceptor.interceptors, 'run')
+    mocker.patch.object(interceptor.websettings, 'user_agent', return_value='test')
+    custom_headers = mocker.spy(shared, 'custom_headers')
+
+    interceptor.RequestInterceptor().interceptRequest(info)
+
+    custom_headers.assert_called_once_with(
+        url=url, fallback_accept_language=fallback)
+    accept_language_calls = [
+        call for call in info.setHttpHeader.call_args_list
+        if call.args[0] == b'Accept-Language'
+    ]
+    assert accept_language_calls == (
+        [mocker.call(b'Accept-Language', b'global')] if fallback else [])
+
+
